algorithm: Compute the binomial coefficient binom(2n, n) = (2n)! / (n! * n!)
Divide the result by (n + 1) to get the Catalan number
Ensure the result is an integer (the Catalan numbers are always integers for integer n >= 0)
constraints: n must be an integer between 0 and 35 inclusive
The result must be an exact integer with arbitrary precision (no symbolic results)
inputs: An integer n in the range 0 to 35 (inclusive).
output: The exact integer value of the nth Catalan number, C_n = (1/(n+1)) * binom(2n, n).
purpose: Compute the exact integer value of the nth Catalan number using the binomial coefficient formula with arbitrary precision.
